cards.title: Inflation right now
cards.how: Trend word = the last 3 months' pace vs the past year.

variants.headline: Core CPI inflation is 2.56% over the past year and heating up.
lines: Core means without food and energy, whose prices jump around.
2 of 4 measures are cooling, 2 heating up, 0 steady.
The New York Fed's underlying-trend estimate (MCT) is 2.29% a year (August).

rows.label: Core CPI
rows.text: Prices without food and energy rose 0.33% in September. Over the past year: 2.56%. The last 3 months ran at a 3.41% yearly pace - faster than the past year.

rows.label: CPI
rows.text: All prices rose 0.65% in September. Over the past year: 3.74%. The last 3 months ran at a 4.56% yearly pace - faster than the past year.

rows.label: Core PCE

rows.label: PCE

models.label: Every locked forecast (forecast card first, then each of our models)

s_bonds.title: Do bonds still protect stocks?
s_bonds.def: How 10-year Treasury bond returns have moved with stock returns: the slope of the bond return on the stock return over the last 90 calendar days (operational nominal bond beta).

s_coming.title: Coming up
s_coming.def: The next four CPI, PCE and PPI release dates and times (New York time).

s_drivers.title: What's pushing prices
s_drivers.def: San Francisco Fed split of headline PCE inflation over the past 12 months into supply-driven, demand-driven and ambiguous categories (points of inflation; they add up to the total).

s_inflation_now.title: Inflation right now
s_inflation_now.def: Year-over-year inflation of four measures, the latest monthly change and the 3-month pace, latest revised data.

s_markets.title: What markets expect
s_markets.def: 10-year breakeven = 10-year Treasury yield minus 10-year TIPS yield: inflation compensation (expected inflation plus risk and liquidity premia).

s_surprise.title: What a CPI surprise does
s_surprise.def: Estimated average same-day move of SPY or QQQ for a core CPI surprise of -0.2, 0 or +0.2 points against the Cleveland Fed nowcast, from past release days, with the range for one such day and the range of the average.

s_trust.title: Which forecasts to trust
s_trust.def: A plain-words summary of the walk-forward evaluations: typical miss of each inflation forecaster on the shared releases, and whether models with more data beat simple ones for stocks, swings and drop odds.

top_cpi_day.title: CPI day
top_cpi_day.def: How SPY or QQQ has moved on core CPI release days, and the fitted average same-day move for a core CPI surprise of 0.1 points against the Cleveland Fed nowcast, with the range for one such day and the range of the average.

top_inflation.title: Next inflation release
top_inflation.def: Our best guess for the next CPI, PCE or PPI release (monthly change, first release, rounded to 0.1 when published), core and headline. Yearly pace = the monthly change compounded over 12 months.

top_stocks.title: Stocks
top_stocks.def: The stock window that starts at the close after the last month-end: middle estimate and range (10th to 90th percentile of past misses) of the excess return over cash, how often such ranges held in the walk-forward test, expected volatility, and the chance of a 5% drop below the entry close.

track_cpi_day.title: Track record · CPI day
track_cpi_day.def: Backtest of the CPI-day card's 9-in-10 range for one release day, refit on earlier days only. Cleveland Fed numbers = its daily nowcast history as published today (no archived versions).

track_drop.title: Track record · 5% drop odds
track_drop.def: Backtest of the stock card's 5% drop odds against whether a close at least 5% below the starting close came during the window.

track_inflation.title: Track record · Next inflation release
track_inflation.def: Backtest of the forecast card's next-release best guess: for each past CPI, PCE or PPI release, the forecaster with the lowest typical miss on the earlier releases (the next one when it had no forecast), its forecast and 8-in-10 range (10th to 90th percentile of its own earlier misses), against the first-release actual. Cleveland Fed numbers = its daily nowcast history as published today (no archived versions).

track_overview.title: How the checks work
track_overview.def: Backtest = rebuilt for each date using only what was known then. Live = locked in before the event and never changed.

track_stocks.title: Track record · Stocks
track_stocks.def: Backtest of the stock card's middle estimate and range (the plain historical average and its 80% range) against the realized return over cash.

track_swings.title: Track record · Swings
track_swings.def: Backtest of the stock card's expected swings (yearly volatility) against the realized volatility.
